full_prompt_en: A square dramatic anime illustration shows a young boxer resting a wrapped hand on a red glove while staring intently toward the right. The background is an indistinct deep teal-gray, softly textured and dark enough to hold the figure forward. The boy fills the frame from the shoulders upward, leaning low with a compressed, ready posture. Thick black hair flares in uneven spikes, and long strands fall across the forehead above wide brown eyes. Strong dark brows angle down toward the nose, sharpening his focused expression. A warm stripe of light cuts across the cheek and bridge of the nose, while one side of the face remains in brown shadow. He wears a loose red outer layer over a pale shirt, its folds described by broad dark red planes. Across the lower center, a forearm wrapped in off-white cloth rests horizontally near the mouth. The bandages show many small creases and dirt-tinted fibers, and a red glove rises at the lower right beside the wrapped hand. Another red rounded form appears at the lower left, helping the foreground enclose the face. The viewpoint sits slightly above the crouched boxer and close enough to crop the hair and clothing at the edges. Fine drawn lines around the eyes and hand give the pose specificity, while broader paintlike shading and subtle grain make the image more tactile than flat cel animation. Directional warm light arrives from the upper right, picking out cheek, bandages, and glove curves and leaving the hair and far shoulder dark. The overall composition is compact and tense, using crossed forearm, fixed gaze, and red foreground forms to suggest concentration before action.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形戏剧性动漫插画呈现一位年轻拳手，把缠带的手搭在红拳套旁，目光坚定地望向右侧。背景是不明确的深青灰色，带柔和肌理且足够暗，使人物向前突出。男孩从肩部以上填满画幅，低身前倾，姿态紧缩而蓄势。浓密黑发不齐地翘起，长发丝落在额头上方宽大的棕色眼睛前。浓深眉毛斜向鼻梁，强化专注神情。一道暖色光横切脸颊和鼻梁，半边脸仍留在棕色阴影中。他在浅色衬衫外穿宽松红色上衣，其褶皱由宽阔深红平面描述。下方中央，一条缠着灰白布条的前臂水平搭在嘴边附近。绷带上有许多细小褶皱和染上污色的纤维，右下方一个红拳套在缠带的手旁升起。左下也出现一块红色圆润形体，使前景围住面孔。视点略高于低伏拳手，并贴近到发梢与衣服被画边裁去。眼睛和手周围的细绘线赋予姿势具体感，较宽的绘画式阴影和轻微颗粒又使画面比平坦赛璐珞动画更可触。定向暖光从右上方进入，提亮脸颊、绷带和拳套曲面，使头发和远侧肩膀较暗。整体构图紧凑而绷紧，以横置前臂、固定目光和红色前景形体暗示行动前的集中精神。
style_prompt_en: The dramatic anime rendering combines strong expressive facial lines with broad painterly shadow and fine surface grain. Warm red occupies several close, heavy masses, while deep teal-gray and black hold the surroundings in a subdued counterfield. A narrow directional highlight cuts across a few key planes, leaving large neighboring areas dark; this concentrated light gives the image immediate tension. Curved foreground forms overlap the focal center and tighten the crop. Crisp line details around eyes, seams, and fabric creases coexist with softer transitions in shadowed areas. Skin tones are warm but slightly muted, and off-white accents give relief between red and dark values. The composition favors a low compressed pose seen closely, with diagonals feeding into the concentrated gaze. The overall effect is gritty and kinetic despite the stillness, grounded in tangible texture and decisive value design.
style_prompt_zh: 这种戏剧性动漫渲染把有力的表情线条与宽阔绘画式阴影、细小表面颗粒结合。暖红色占据数块贴近而沉重的体块，深青灰与黑色让周围退为低调对场。狭窄定向高光切过少数关键平面，邻近大面积留暗；集中的光让画面立即产生张力。弯曲前景形体遮挡焦点中心，收紧裁切。眼睛、接缝和衣布褶皱周围的清脆细线与暗处更柔和的过渡并存。肤色偏暖但略低调，灰白色重音在红色与深明度之间提供喘息。构图偏爱贴近观看的低伏压缩姿态，斜线汇入集中的目光。整体效果虽然静止却粗粝而有动势，扎根于可触肌理和果断的明度设计。
theme_en: A determined young boxer resting a wrapped hand on a red glove
theme_zh: 坚定的年轻拳手把缠带的手搭在红拳套上
name: Hajime no Ippo
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
